{"notes": "VISIT 4 (6:30). Ratings still provisional. I still don't know who placed which dominoes, so no one gets credit or blame for the picture itself.

TABLE STATE: Every domino is dark, so the whole fish is connected to the start. The upper and lower lines meet at the notch near (25,10). No pale pieces, no gaps, and no hands on the table. It looks ready for the push.

OMAR: He said the notch looks fine and called hands off. That is a reasonable status, though it's the only check I heard. His earlier plan (five dominoes on the tip, curving down) matched the result. He's reliable and specific. Execution looks good, but I only see the outcome.

HANA: She closed with 'Nice work, all. Hands off and we wait for the push.' I didn't hear her say she'd checked the tail and fork, as she promised at visit 3. The picture looks fine, so there's no harm, but her follow-through is unconfirmed. Leadership is good from earlier coordination. Ask her whether she did the check.

JACK: He kept clear of the tail, encouraged Omar and thanked others. He accurately said the body is dark from the nose and kept his hands off. Collaboration is strong.

SOFIA: She agreed with the team, said the fish falls from the nose and to wait for the push. She is supportive, but I have still seen no hands-on work from her. Her checking claim is unverified. No penalty without evidence, but I can't credit impact or execution beyond supportiveness.

TO DO: Ask privately who closed the gap and who checked the join. Ask Sofia and Hana what they each contributed. Watch the push result before finalizing ratings."}
